top_signals.title: Indonesia Arrests Former Top Graft Prosecutor After Police Raids
top_signals.summary: Indonesia’s former top graft prosecutor was arrested on suspicion of money laundering, weeks after police raids uncovered $26 million worth of gold bars and cash at a house he owns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Modi Sidesteps Exam Leaks in Video as India Protests Spread
top_signals.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi repeatedly thanked the nation’s youth in a video message Friday night, offering no indication he would meet their key demand to remove the education minister as student protests widen.
